text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On Copano Rickey's recommendation,
today she
and I are visiting a national
park located in a
lucky direction.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, dearie me! If it isn't Rickey and her
trainer!
Fancy seeing you here.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Acute! I never imagined we'd bump
into you
here!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I came here for a neighborhood
association
gathering. Everyone's out
and about playing
games and having a
barbecue.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how about you two join us? The

neighborhood association head said we
were
allowed to invite people we know.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I do! Thank you for inviting us, Acute!
choice_data_list: 楽しそうだし、リッキーが参加したいなら
choice_data_list_en: It looks fun, and if Rickey wants to join in...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
All right, all you good girls and boys!
How about
a game of tag before lunch?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: I'll be it, and you have to run away without being caught. Got it? Reeeady, GO!

text_block_list.name: Neighborhood Association Kids
text_block_list.text: Aaaah!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Here ya go! One grilled carrot! They're
piping
hot, so be careful not to burn
your mouths!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You're next! You said you don't like
vegetables,
but I'm sure you won't have
problems if you
gobble them down with
some meat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is busily grilling and
handing out
skewers for all the
neighborhood association
attendees.
She looks to be enjoying herself, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. I'll put some food
aside for
you, Rickey.
choice_data_list: 自分の食事のこと、忘れていそうだ
自分の食事のこと、忘れていそう
choice_data_list_en: Looks like you've completely forgotten about your own meal.
Looks like you might've forgotten about your own meal.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! I had loads of fun, grilled some
meat, and
had a great time with
everyone. I really soaked up
tons of
good energy!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grumble...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, haha! And I might be a teensy bit
hungry too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've grilled you some meat, Rickey.
There's tons
more, if you want seconds.
choice_data_list: 何も食べずに動き回ってたしな
何も食べずに動き回ってたしね
choice_data_list_en: You were running around on an empty stomach, after all.
You were running around on an empty stomach, after all.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, have some tea, too. Fill your
stomach and
take it easy!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay! Don't mind if I do! The meat
looks
amazi—ngh?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Come now, drink your tea. Let me give
you a
little back massage too.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no need to rush. The food isn't
going
anywhere. Make sure you chew
properly so that
you absorb the
nutrients better and you don't
choke.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Hehe, okaaay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey is usually the one
looking after
others, but when she's with
Wonder Acute, it
seems the roles are
reversed.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Snore...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, she fell asleep before she even
finished
eating. I'll throw a blanket over
her legs so that
she won't catch a cold.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Why, it's the least I can do
considering
how much she helps me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just like you saw today, Rickey always
puts others
before herself. She used to
have me worried
sometimes.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But now, she has a trainer by her side to
look out
for her.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Please keep watching over her,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Please keep watching over her,
okay?
choice_data_list: 俺が彼女をハッピーにするよ！
私が彼女をハッピーにするよ！
リッキーのことは任せて！

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... You know how Rickey is often
going on
about "generative cycles"? All
that about people
being each other's
support?
choice_data_list: 俺が彼女をハッピーにするよ！
私が彼女をハッピーにするよ！
リッキーのことは任せて！

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have no doubt that Rickey has
been filled
with happiness since the
moment she met you,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Let's go, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if she's dreaming about racing?
Seeing
her peaceful sleeping face fills
me with warmth.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
How dependable! I'll be able to rest
easy now.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
What is it Rickey always says? Rickey,
lucky, um...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's it! I'm super happy too! Isn't that
right,
Rickey?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Gehehe... Everyone's so happy... Snore...
